title: Flow connections
intro: The Flow instances Astrolabe reads team capacity and rosters from. Astrolabe only reads from Flow; nothing is ever written back. Administrators manage the connections.
loadFailed: Could not load the Flow connections
notFound: This Flow connection does not exist (or was deleted).

field.baseUrlHint: Flow's address, exactly one of the origins the operator listed for this server. A capital letter, a default port or a trailing slash is corrected for you; any other port is fine as listed.
field.baseUrlNoneAllowed: No Flow origin is configured on this server yet: the operator lists one in FLOW_ALLOWED_HOSTS, or FLOW_INSECURE_ORIGINS in development.
field.baseUrlFixed: The address is the connection's identity and cannot change. Create a new connection for another Flow.
field.timeZoneHint: The IANA zone (Europe/Warsaw) that turns Flow's sprint and membership instants into dates; use the zone Flow's metrics run in.
field.apiTokenHint: A Flow service token (flow_int_ followed by 43 characters), issued in Flow under Administration. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
field.apiTokenKeep: A token is stored. Leave blank to keep the current token, or enter a new one to replace it.
field.apiTokenMissing: No token is stored. Enter one.
field.pollIntervalHint: How often Astrolabe reads Flow on its own: every 5 minutes up to once a day (1440); a sprint calendar changes a few times a week, so the default is hourly. A connection that is disabled or not yet tested is not polled.

validation.baseUrlInvalid: Enter Flow's address as an origin only: http:// or https://, the host and an optional port (any port), with no path, query or credentials
validation.timeZoneInvalid: Enter an IANA time zone such as Europe/Warsaw (a bare offset such as +02:00 is not one)
validation.apiTokenInvalid: A Flow service token is flow_int_ followed by 43 characters

saveForbidden: Only administrators can manage Flow connections
saveConflict: A connection with this name already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This connection no longer exists — reload the page
deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's teams, sprints and members, and every link between an Astrolabe team and a Flow team made through it will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyNoLinks: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's teams, sprints and members. No team was linked in its last read. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyLinks_one: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's data, and its {{count}} team link will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
deleteBodyLinks_other: “{{name}}” will be deleted with its run history and its copy of Flow's data, and its {{count}} team links will be unlinked. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.

toast.savedRetest: Connection saved. Test it again, the settings changed

test.truncated: Flow cut its document at its limits (1,000 teams, 2,000 sprints). A run keeps what arrived and logs a warning.
test.rateLimited: Too many tests in a minute. Wait a moment and try again.
test.failedGeneric: The test could not run. Check your connection and try again.

errorCode.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Flow rejected the token: it was revoked or expired - issue a new one in Flow and update the connection
errorCode.NOT_FOUND: Flow does not serve this endpoint; it needs Flow 1.57.0 or later
errorCode.RATE_LIMITED: Flow is rate limiting this token; try again later
errorCode.TIMEOUT: Flow did not answer in time
errorCode.BUSY: Too many Flow calls are in flight; try again in a moment
errorCode.INVALID_RESPONSE: Flow sent an answer that could not be read
errorCode.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Flow's answer passed a safety limit
errorCode.BLOCKED_HOST: Flow's address is not on the operator's list of allowed origins
errorCode.REDIRECT: Flow answered with a redirect, which is refused
errorCode.TIME_ZONE_INVALID: The connection's time zone is not known to this server; correct it

details.testedBefore: Not tested since the connection was last changed

refresh.invalid: This connection cannot be refreshed (it is disabled or gone)
refresh.alreadyRunning: A refresh is already running for this connection. Its progress shows in the table below.
refresh.running: A refresh is running. The table below updates by itself.

teams.title: Teams
teams.intro: The Flow teams this connection last read. Link each to the Astrolabe team it stands for: a linked team can import its capacity from Flow and shows Flow's roster.
teams.loadFailed: Could not load the Flow teams
teams.emptyHint: No Flow data has been read yet. Use Refresh now above (test the connection first if it has not been tested).
teams.summary: Flow teams: {{teams}} · linked: {{linked}} · with a suggestion: {{suggested}}
teams.disabledNote: The connection is disabled: teams cannot be linked until it is enabled.
teams.unlinkBody: Astrolabe team “{{team}}” will no longer be linked to Flow team “{{flowTeam}}”. Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.
teams.unlinkForbidden: Only administrators or the team's manager can unlink it
teams.unlinkGone: This link no longer exists — it was already removed
teams.linkForbidden: Only administrators or the team's manager can link it
teams.linkConflict: The link conflicts with an existing one
teams.linkInvalid: The link was refused: refresh the connection and try again
teams.matchResult: {{linked}} linked, {{noMatch}} without a unique match, {{already}} linked already.
teams.matchFailed: Could not link the suggested teams

panel.title: Flow
panel.loadFailed: Could not load the Flow link
panel.notLinked: Not linked to a Flow team
panel.notLinkedHint: Link the team to its Flow team to import its capacity and to see Flow's roster. Astrolabe only reads from Flow.
panel.notLinkedReadOnly: The team's manager or an administrator can link it to its Flow team.
panel.goneNote: The connection has read Flow and this team is not in it any more. The link stays until it is removed; capacity already imported stays. Importing capacity is unavailable.
panel.disabledNote: The connection is disabled: Flow is not read again until an administrator enables it. The last data read stays.
panel.stale: Could not refresh the Flow link; the last data read is shown.
panel.importBlocked: Capacity cannot be imported while a schedule proposal is open.
panel.sprintsNext: Sprints read from Flow: {{n}} · the next starts {{date}}
panel.unlinkBody: This team will no longer be linked to Flow team “{{flowTeam}}” (connection “{{connection}}”). Capacity already imported stays. Nothing is changed in Flow.

capacity.missing_one: No capacity in the plan for {{count}} sprint
capacity.missing_other: No capacity in the plan for {{count}} sprints
capacity.loadFailed: Could not compare the capacity with Flow
capacity.fix: Import capacity… shows what an import would change. Hand-entered periods are left as they are, and a sprint where Flow has 0 must be ticked by hand.
capacity.noneSoFar: No difference in the data read so far

link.title: Link to a Flow team
link.intro: Choose the Flow team that stands for “{{team}}”. Astrolabe only reads from Flow.
link.suggestionHint: The team of the same name is preselected.
link.noSuggestion: No Flow team has this team's name; choose the one that stands for it.
link.nothingFound: No Flow team of this name
link.allLinked: Every Flow team of this connection is linked already.
link.notRead: This connection has not read Flow yet. An administrator refreshes it on the connection page first.
link.noConnection: No Flow connection exists yet. An administrator adds one under Administration, Flow.
link.noEnabledConnection: Every Flow connection is disabled. An administrator enables one under Administration, Flow.

roster.title: Roster
roster.currentAria: Current members of the Flow team
roster.formerAria: Former members of the Flow team
roster.noCurrent: Flow lists no current members for this team.
roster.unavailable: The roster is not available: the Flow team is gone from the last read.

capacity.manualOnEdit: This period was imported from Flow sprint “{{sprint}}”. Saving a change makes it a hand-entered period: later imports will never touch it.
capacity.manualOnEditNoSprint: This period was imported from Flow. Saving a change makes it a hand-entered period: later imports will never touch it.

import.title: Import capacity from Flow
import.intro: Flow's man-days per sprint become man-days per week over each sprint's working days, one period per sprint start. Tick the rows to import. A hand-entered period is never changed or removed. Nothing is changed in Flow.
import.loadFailed: Could not load the import preview
import.empty: Nothing to import: Flow lists no sprints for this team in this range.
import.removalsIntro: Flow periods imported earlier that no sprint reuses now. Nothing is removed unless you tick it. Removing a period without importing its sprint's new row leaves the earlier sprint's figure in force over those days.
import.removalsAria: Flow periods that would be removed

reason.NO_DATES: Flow has no usable dates for this sprint.
reason.NO_CAPACITY: Flow has no capacity figure for this sprint.
reason.NO_WORKING_DAY: The sprint has no working day.
reason.OVERLAPS: It lies wholly inside an earlier sprint: Flow counts no day for it.
reason.OUT_OF_RANGE: The figure is outside what a period can hold.
reason.MANUAL_PERIOD: A hand-entered period starts on this date and is never changed.

info.MANUAL_PERIOD_INSIDE: A hand-entered period starts on {{date}}, inside the sprint: the sprint's figure will not hold from then.
info.ZERO_CAPACITY: Flow's figure is 0 man-days: not selected by default.
info.LONG_WINDOW: This sprint spans {{days}} calendar days, more than Flow's 60-day cap for a sprint calendar: check its dates in Jira before importing it. Flow lets every sprint within the 60-day cap claim its days first, so this one counts only the days left, and its figure holds only until the next sprint's period. Not selected by default.
info.FIXED_FIGURE: Flow's figure is a fixed total for the whole sprint, so it is spread over the sprint's {{days}} working days; some of its days belong to an earlier sprint.

import.closedNote: Ended before {{from}}: not selected by default.
import.summary: Selected: {{total}} · to create: {{create}} · to update: {{update}} · to remove: {{remove}}
import.footer: Each imported period holds until the next one starts, so after the last imported sprint its figure stays in force until you import again.
import.forbidden: Only the team's manager or an administrator can import capacity
import.gone: This link or team no longer exists — reload the page
